run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot to apply FP4 quantization to a causal language model using a calibration dataset
create_quantization_modifier: create a QuantizationModifier targeting Linear layers with NVFP4 scheme and ignore lm_head
run_dispatch_model: run dispatch_model to offload a quantized model for inference on available devices
create_model_from_pretrained: create a causal language model from pretrained weights using AutoModelForCausalLM
save_quantized_model_pretrained: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
